SCAM.headline: This is a scam
SCAM.default: Don't tap any link, don't send any money and don't share any OTP. Call {son}.
SCAM.kyc_account_block: Real banks never ask you to update KYC through a link. Don't tap the link and don't send any money. Call {son}.
SCAM.digital_arrest: No police officer or court arrests anyone over a phone or video call. Don't send any money and don't stay on the call. Call {son}.
SCAM.malicious_apk: Real banks and offices never ask you to install an app from a link. Don't install it and don't open the link. Call {son}.
SCAM.electricity_disconnect: The electricity office never cuts power over a message like this. Don't tap the link and don't call the number. Call {son}.
SCAM.courier_parcel: Real couriers don't ask for payment through a link. Don't tap the link and don't pay anything. Call {son}.
SCAM.family_emergency: Money is being asked for in a hurry, which is how scammers work. Don't send anything until you have spoken to the person yourself. Call {son}.
SCAM.task_job_offer: Real jobs don't pay you for likes or small tasks, or ask you to pay first. Don't reply and don't send any money. Call {son}.
SCAM.investment_tips: Nobody can promise safe, quick profits. Don't send any money and don't join the group. Call {son}.
SCAM.lottery_prize: You cannot win a prize you never entered. Don't tap the link and don't pay any fee. Call {son}.
SCAM.upi_collect_refund: Approving a request sends money out of your account, it never brings money in. Don't approve it and don't enter your PIN. Call {son}.
SCAM.otp_phishing: Real banks never ask for your OTP or PIN. Don't share it with anyone. Call {son}.

SUSPICIOUS.headline: Be careful
SUSPICIOUS.default: This message is rushing you to act. Don't tap any link or reply, and check with {son} first.

SAFE.headline: This looks like a normal message
SAFE.default: Nothing here asks for money or a link tap. If anything feels odd, check with {son}.
SAFE.genuine_otp: This is a real OTP from your bank. Never share an OTP with anyone.

UNKNOWN.headline: Couldn't check right now
UNKNOWN.default: The home computer is offline. Don't open any links, and call {son}.
